method: Fresh prepare + design for both arms on 55 fixed native masks, with captured production settings and candidate observers. Alternating arm order; the baseline loader substitutes only the preceding boundary.js. Times include preparation and solving, excluding file writes, independent render and editable conversion. One pair per mask, not repeated latency measurements.
qualifications: This fixed-mask replay does not rerun the 31-photo cropper. The existing nested-squares and santa no-crop cases remain excluded from the 29-mask photo subset, not counted as successes.

Pass requires template checks, source-feature fidelity and the configured image-error limit. Independent mask agreement is not agreement with unknown original cutting paths or evidence of physical assembly.
Exact fixed-geometry gradients do not make wall-clock-budgeted search deterministic. Five photo error increases are retained; timing and checkpoint diagnostics are prepared separately.
